subject: Emotions
title: Exposure Therapy for Disgust
description: A quick win: understand Exposure Therapy for Disgust.

hook.text: A therapist asks a patient to touch a toilet seat and resist washing for an hour. Anxiety spikes, then fades.

buildup.text: Exposure and response prevention is the gold standard for disgust-based disorders like contamination OCD.

discovery.text: The brain learns that not acting on disgust doesn't lead to harm. The false alarm loses its power.

twist.text: Virtual reality exposure now works too. Digital contamination triggers real disgust that can be treated.

climax.text: Success rates exceed 60%. Most patients maintain gains years later once the circuit is retrained.

punchline.text: The cure for irrational disgust is controlled contact.

quiz.question: What is the gold standard treatment for contamination OCD?
